name: Lemon and Garlic Lamb Rib Chops
ingredients: 1⁄2 cup – white wine or chicken broth

Chops: Heat some oil in a skillet
Season both sides of the chops with salt and pepper.
Sear lamb chops in a hot skillet for 3 minutes per side. Set aside.
Sauce: Don’t clean the skillet, the little brown bits become the foundation of your sauce.
Add 1-2 Tbsp of butter to skillet.
Add minced shallot / onion to the skillet and sauté until glossy and brown
Add 1 clove of sliced garlic and 1⁄2 tsp of thyme and sauté for 30 seconds.
De glaze the pan with 1⁄2 cup of white wine or chicken broth and juice from 1⁄2 a lemon.
Simmer for 3-5 minutes. The lemon juice balances the richness of the lamb and butter (which gives the sauce body).
Serve: Pour sauce over lamb chops and serve with salad, rice, or potatoes.

additional_context.tips: Lamb chops are lean and tender. Cook them like a tenderloin or good cut of beef. Add your favourite rub or seasoning and pan fry or grill for 3 minutes per side for medium rare. Medium-rare = 145˚F
